post.title: Money resolutions don't fail from willpower. Here's the data
post.ig:
94% vs 64%. The gap isn't willpower.
Fidelity (Dec 2025): saving more was the top money resolution for 2026 (44%).
Vanguard, 2025: participation was 94% in 401(k) plans that auto-enroll, vs 64% in opt-in plans. 61% of Vanguard plans auto-enrolled by 2025, up from 48% in 2018.
A 2004 Save More Tomorrow study: workers who pre-committed future raises went from saving 3.5% to 13.6% in 40 months.
Our math: $50 automatic transfer every two weeks (26 times) = $1,300 a year.
Sources: Fidelity (Dec 2025), Vanguard How America Saves, Thaler and Benartzi (2004).
